title: fix(lint): one-line fix lines for the twelve lint-flow-patterns anti-pattern rule ids (slice 20); os explain carries what they explained
body:
Part of #22161
Clause-②: no

Slice 20 of the card: the twelve `lint-flow-patterns.ts` rule ids that slice 2 fenced, now inside the card's close condition (triage answer A, comment `6219576699`), in slices 11–19's shape. Each finding's `hint` of these 12 ids (the CLI's `fix:` line, the runtime finding's `hint`) is now one remedy line of at most 200 characters, and what the lines used to explain is each id's new `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` entry behind `os explain RULE_ID`. The card stays open: the last section lists what is left.

Claim: `6223378557` (the newest `Claim:` on the card, naming this branch; verified before work resumed). This is a resumed run: a container restart cut the first run off after it pushed three commits (`80fe70c259`, `ff37108a51`, `afe0351ce7`) with no PR. Those commits were re-verified against the order hunk by hunk, kept, and finished here. `main` was merged once. Three corrections were made:
- the minimal-`catch` docblock again names `flows.mdx`, which writes the same region out;
- the changeset gains the `api`-trigger reading;
- one entry sentence was fixed. It quoted "`os migrate meta --from 17`" inside a plain string literal, and the spec class pin `shared/retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts` judges that as a migrate prescription. The first run never ran the spec `repo` project, so it went unseen. That project went red on it here, and the fix names the bare command, the way the other entries' descriptive prose does.

No file outside the claim's surface is touched.

## What changes

**One remedy line per finding.** Every hint the lint suite fires for the twelve ids, before → after (distinct hints · length range), measured with the push-preload census (an `Array.prototype.push` preload over the whole lint suite plus an `Array.prototype.map` leg). Before is `main` at `2b274600b1` (its `packages/lint` is byte-identical to this branch's merge base `cf31c34823`); after is this branch. The runtime column is a scratch probe of the runtime gate (below), FROM → TO.

| rule id | lint suite, before → after | runtime door |
|---|---|---|
| `flow-loop-body-uncontained` | 1 · 800 → 1 · 174 | 2xx advisory, 800 → 174 |
| `flow-multi-write-unfiltered` | 3 · 684–695 → 1 · 73 | 2xx advisory, 695 → 73 and 684 → 73 |
| `flow-try-catch-without-catch` | 1 · 594 → 1 · 137 | 2xx advisory, 594 → 137 |
| `flow-decision-inclusive-overlap` | 1 · 437 → 1 · 159 | 2xx advisory, 437 → 159 |
| `flow-approval-revise-target-not-service-owned` | 1 · 412 → 1 · 76 | 422 issue, 412 → 76 |
| `flow-time-relative-antipattern` | 1 · 397 → 1 · 163 | 2xx advisory, 397 → 163 |
| `flow-date-equality-filter` | 3 · 370–379 → 3 · 114–123 | 2xx advisory, 379 → 123 |
| `flow-runas-unscoped` | 3 · 362–372 → 1 · 105 | 422 issue, 367 → 105 (schedule), 372 → 105 (time-relative), 362 → 105 (api) |
| `flow-decision-mode-invalid` | 1 · 295 → 1 · 134 | 422 issue, 295 → 134 |
| `flow-decision-unconditional-branch` | 2 · 142–286 → 2 · 142–149 | 2xx advisory, 286 → 149 (no-gate arm); the mixed arm's 142 is unchanged |
| `flow-error-label-not-fault` | 1 · 239 → 1 · 81 | 2xx advisory, 239 → 81 |
| `flow-branch-label-unmatched` | 1 · 224 → 1 · 122 | 422 issue, 224 → 122 |

Measured on `main` first, as the order asked: all twelve were over 200 there, at exactly the lengths the seat's record `6217435246` lists, so all twelve change. Counts that fall are interpolations that no longer make a hint distinct: the object name in the bulk-write line and the trigger kind in the `runAs` line stay in their messages.

**What each line says now.** The remedy alone: where the node goes and the minimal `catch` region (the two containment ids), the constraint to write (bulk write), the `mode` to delete or the edge to gate (decision ids), the node type to set (approval revise), the declared `timeRelative` sweep (time-relative), the one-day window (date equality), `runAs:'system'` (runAs), `type: 'fault'` (error label), and the label to match (branch label).

**`os explain` carries the rest.** Each of the twelve ids gains a `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` entry, so its `rule:` line now carries the `os explain` pointer. What the lines stopped saying is there: which node types count as able to fail and how containment is judged; the two empty `catch` spellings the parse refuses, what the minimal handler may omit, and the measured result with it; when failing fast or retry-then-fail is a legitimate reading; the worked `showcase_inquiry_purge` example, keeping a meant whole-object write, and how the rule differs from the run-time erased-condition guard; when to keep `mode: 'inclusive'` and where `os migrate meta` left it on a flow authored against protocol major 17; what ends the revise window and why ADR-0044's amendment moved it off `wait`; the hand-written range-query alternative to the declared sweep; why abutting one-day windows match each row once; why a user-less run is refused rather than run unscoped, and the anonymous-endpoint exception (ADR-0138 D2b, in the spec `runAs` description's own words); that `registerFlow` refuses an invalid `mode` with the same sentence; dropping `type: 'decision'` for a meant fan-out; which failures a `fault` edge routes and which labels read as an error path; and one branching mechanism per decision. Every fact in the entries was checked against the rule source, its docblocks, the spec, ADR-0138 and the showcase flows it names. The twelve rule-id constants were already root-barrel exports, and the new entry constants are module-local; `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` (already published) gains twelve keys. So no published name is added and `Clause-②: no` holds.

**Nothing else moves.** Every `message`, rule id, severity and `path` is unchanged, and so is what each rule accepts or refuses. Proven mechanically, not only by reading the hunks: the census also records each finding's `message`, `where`, `path` and `severity`, and for each of the twelve ids the set of those tuples is identical on `main` and on this branch (29, 9, 3, 2, 2, 3, 3, 12, 4, 7, 11 and 4 tuples, zero differing). The rule-file hunks are `hint` expressions, comments, and the two `catch`-spelling constants folded into one (`MINIMAL_CATCH_REGION`).

### File surface: the claim's

`packages/lint/src/lint-flow-patterns.ts`, its test, `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (entries for these twelve ids only, in one new block after the slice-19 flow entries), and `.changeset/22161-s20-flow-patterns-fix-lines.md`. None of the other 8 fenced ids, `lint-startup-registry-verdict.ts` or `content/docs/**` is touched. **Pin sweep, repo-wide** (`git grep` of each id, the two removed constants and every distinctive old phrase, docs and examples included): only `packages/lint/src` tests pin these hints. The metadata-protocol, objectql and spec tests that name these ids assert the rule id or the channel, or use hand-written fixtures; none reads the hint text. So no `packages/cli` or `packages/metadata-protocol` rider was needed.

## The runtime wire

`lintFlowPatterns` runs at the runtime gate on a `flow` write (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, called by `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`, whose `toIssue` copies `hint` verbatim into the 422 `issues[]` and the 2xx `advisories[]`). A scratch probe of 16 writes, run against `main`'s two rule sources and against this branch's, shows all twelve ids firing (column above). Four ids land on the 422 refusal (`flow-approval-revise-target-not-service-owned`, `flow-runas-unscoped`, `flow-decision-mode-invalid`, `flow-branch-label-unmatched`; the severity-`error` ids) and the other eight as 2xx advisories. No write changes channel; every case ran 9 rules on both sides.

## Verification

Final head `051e299753`. Heavy runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (slot `issue-22161-s20`), and each reading below is its `VERDICT` line. Every exit code was captured before any pipe.

- **Lint suite.** The `main` leg uses rule sources and test from `2b274600b1`, written into the tree only and restored from `HEAD` under a trap: 141 files / 6802 passed. At `051e299753`: 141 / 6817 passed. The +15 is the new describe block. VERDICT 0 both.
- **Lint build and typecheck** at `051e299753`, VERDICT 0. Build is `tsup` plus `check-dts-emitted` (6/6 declaration files). Typecheck is `tsc` plus `check:test-typecheck` OK (2 files / 6 errors / 2 pinned, unchanged).
- **Census and shape invariance.** Run at `bd68f8b667`; the rule source's blob `cbb7afbc7dd3` is identical at `051e299753`. Since then only an entry paragraph, two assertion strings and the changeset changed. Results are in the table and section above.
- **Runtime probe.** 16 writes through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` with `tsx`, `main`'s two rule sources vs the branch's, at the same rule-source blob. Results are in the table above.
- **CLI unit tier** (`--project unit`) at `5b33669812`: 307 files / 4573 passed, VERDICT 0.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` whole suite** at `5b33669812`: 242 passed | 3 skipped files, 20612 passed | 19 skipped, VERDICT 0.
- **`@objectstack/spec` repo project** (`--project repo`, which reads `packages/lint/src` as a corpus).
  - At `5b33669812`: 64 files passed, 1 failed, 3 failed | 1096 passed. The failure is the class pin above, naming `lint:rule-explanations.ts:3637`, VERDICT 1.
  - At `051e299753`, that pin file alone: 15/15 passed, VERDICT 0.
  - At `051e299753`, the whole project: 65 files / 1099 passed, VERDICT 0.
- **`objectstack validate`** (built CLI, lint rebuilt at `051e299753`) on app-crm, app-todo, app-showcase and app-multi-package: exit 0 each, with 9, 7, 67 and 3 `rule:` lines.
  - Of the twelve ids, only `flow-loop-body-uncontained` fires, twice, on app-showcase's `showcase_nested_fan_out_reminders`. It prints the 174-character `fix:` line, and the `rule:` line carries `` — `os explain flow-loop-body-uncontained` for why a loop body needs its own `try_catch` ``.
  - `objectstack explain flow-decision-inclusive-overlap` and `objectstack explain flow-runas-unscoped`: exit 0, printing the new entries.
- **Ablation**, one shot from the committed `5b33669812`, whose rule-source blob is the final one.
  - Method: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the lock, with an EXIT/INT/TERM trap restoring `HEAD` by absolute path. The lint suite imports the rule from source, so there is no dist leg.
  - Mutation: the old `flow-runas-unscoped` tail restored. Anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `cbb7afbc7dd3` → `33be4751a16d`.
  - Predicted, in writing before the run: exactly two red, the ≤ 200 test and the `it.each` case for `flow-runas-unscoped`.
  - Observed: `lint-flow-patterns.test.ts` 2 failed | 242 passed, exactly those two.
  - Restored: blob == `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, status clean, and the re-run passed 244/244.
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths. 62 families over the 4 changed paths, run one by one. At `051e299753` every one exits 0, and `--ran` reports 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The same 62 also exited 0 at `5b33669812`. For every family CI runs, this PR's own check-runs are the reading.
- **Control characters:** scanned every changed file and this body; no match. A planted control byte was detected.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `runAs` line still prescribes `runAs:'system'`, as it did.** Behind an `authRequired: false` endpoint of `type: 'flow'`, publish refuses `system` (ADR-0138 D2b). The old line did not say so either. The new entry carries the exception in the spec description's own wording, and the refusal is loud, so this is no silent trap.
- **The `mode` line covers both refusals in one sentence.** "Omit `mode` … or set `mode: 'inclusive'` …; a `conditions` list takes no `mode`." For the second arm (a legal `mode` beside a `conditions` list), the last clause is the remedy. That is the same three facts the old line carried, minus the `registerFlow` sentence, which moved to the entry.
- **`main` moved after the one merge.** The branch carries `main` at `2b274600b1`. A sibling's fetch since shows `origin/main` at `b74434c581`, and the order allows one merge before the PR. Further merges are only for a conflict, a `main`-caused red or a queue removal.
- **The census measures what the lint suite fires.** An id that only a CLI path fires, or that no lint test fires, is outside its view, as in slices 17–19. All twelve fire in the suite, on every arm the tests name.

## Remaining for this card (census at `bd68f8b667`, whose rule sources this head keeps: 232 ids fire, 11 over 200, by file)

- The next slice's 8 author-time ids, all in files slice 2 fenced:
  - `validate-flow-template-paths.ts` (2): `flow-template-field-unprovisioned` 362, `flow-template-lookup-traversal` 316;
  - `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` (2): `page-field-unprovisioned` 362, `page-section-group-unknown` 279;
  - `validate-print-page-blocks.ts` (1): `print-page-block-unprintable` 362;
  - `validate-form-layout.ts` (1): `form-section-group-unknown` 275;
  - `validate-filter-tokens.ts` (1): `filter-token-unknown` 259;
  - `validate-component-props.ts` (1): `component-props-invalid` 258.
- Outside the close condition (repo gate, not author-time): `lint-startup-registry-verdict.ts` (3): `startup-open-vocabulary-verdict` 972, `startup-verdict-assertive-wording` 972, `startup-source-unparseable` 254.
- On `main` before this slice the same census read 23 over 200. The difference is exactly these twelve ids.
- The close-out slice still owes the `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx` transcript carry from slice 15's landing record `6136999237`.
